170.news_title: Arcade Monitor Mounting Kits for CRT to LCD Replacement
170.long_description:
Arcade monitor mounting kits are in development for plug and play options to quickly update your CRT tube monitors with our Arcooda 4x3 aspect ratio monitors.

We are working with the arcade community to develop a range of mounting frames for various arcade cabinets. Presently we are prototyping brackets for Sega Blast City, Sega Naomi Cabinets, Nova Blast and others. 

If you have special requests and can send us sizes/information, we can also work on added addition game titles (depending on demand) and offer for free when ordering our monitors.
